label: attack-38-demand_skeptic
system:
You are one member of a red team. You have been given ONE attack surface and you may not stray from it. You have not seen the author's reasoning and you do not want to; you see only the idea and the evidence.

Your job is to kill the idea on your surface. A weak attack wastes everyone's time. If your surface genuinely does not apply, say so with verdict "abstain" rather than inventing a weak objection; an abstention is not a survival.

Output JSON only.
user:
YOUR SURFACE — demand_skeptic:
Nobody actually wants this. The pain is stated, not felt. People say they want it and do not change behaviour. Attack the evidence itself.

IDEA
{
  "id": 38,
  "title": "Handoff Log",
  "unlock": "A vision- and speech-capable model runs on the phone at zero marginal cost and never sends a child's details to a server, so a spoken sentence at the moment it happens becomes a structured, timestamped, exportable row; a Live Activity holds the capture button open across a whole parenting block.",
  "pain": "Parents in high-conflict custody arrangements need a defensible daily record of school times, meals, sleep, medications and behaviour, and free-type it into calendar notes because the court-mandated app has no structured daily log and the notes do not export as a record.",
  "audience": "Parents in court-supervised high-conflict custody arrangements who already use a court-mandated co-parenting app",
  "mechanic": "capture_and_answer",
  "wedge": "Bedtime only, for the first release. When the parenting block begins, a Live Activity sits on the lock screen for its duration; one tap starts a five-second voice note - 'asleep at 8:40, ate dinner, no meds' - and on-device transcription turns it into dated fields that export as a plain PDF and CSV. It records; it does not interpret, advise or score anyone.",
  "moat": "accumulated_personal_corpus",
  "model": "subscription",
  "loop": "professional_recommendation",
  "kill": [
    "Fewer than 20% of parenting blocks get at least one logged entry across a 4-week trial with 40 parents.",
    "More than half of 20 family-law practitioners shown the exported PDF say they would not accept or forward it.",
    "Fewer than 10 of the first 100 paying users arrive through a practitioner referral, meaning the zero-budget loop does not exist.",
    "On-device transcription mis-parses times or medication names in more than 5% of entries, which makes the record worse than the calendar notes it replaces."
  ],
  "why_not_obvious": "The obvious build is another full co-parenting platform with messaging and expense splitting, but the court already mandated one of those and [214] says the gap is a single missing structured daily log, so the right product sits beside the mandated app rather than trying to replace it.",
  "why_now": "The parents in [214] are already speaking and typing the observations at the moment they happen and losing them in a field that will not come back out, and on-device transcription [2] [310] plus a block-long Live Activity [306] turn that same moment into an exportable row at no per-user cost."
}



Return JSON:
{
  "surface": "demand_skeptic",
  "attack": "your strongest specific argument, 2-4 sentences, concrete",
  "strongest_defence": "the best answer the author could give",
  "verdict": "fatal" | "wounded" | "survived" | "abstain",
  "verdict_reason": "one sentence"
}

Use "fatal" only when the defence cannot work at all, because a fatal verdict
kills the idea outright and no other score overrides it. Use "wounded" when the
idea survives but is materially weaker. Use "survived" when your surface is
genuinely well answered.
